meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 容器代理会直接从项目的 .env 文件读取 Anthropic 密钥(API key 或 OAuth 令牌),以环境变量方式传给容器,不再走 OneCLI 网关。只有在 .env 里写上 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 才启用,否则保持原样。
howto.when: 当 .env 里有 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true,并且提供了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 或 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 时,启动容器会触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Anthropic 凭证改成从 .env 读取,不走 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 按本技能步骤改代码并配置开关

howto.what_en: Makes the container agent read Anthropic credentials from .env and pass them in as env vars instead of the OneCLI gateway. Effective only when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set; otherwise unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggered when .env has NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, during container argument construction.

say_en.text: Set up Anthropic credentials from .env and skip the OneCLI gateway.

say_en.text: Enable NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS and put my API key in .env.
